note: The closest thing in this batch to the ICP as Primal describes it on live calls, and it lost anyway. He is 55, senior in product development for a fashion brand, confirmed he can pay in full ('I can pay the 6K. That we know'), is demonstrably not deconditioned, and framed his own aim as going to the next level rather than being rescued. The single miss is the one the stated ICP treats as the entry point: health is not the neglected area of his life, it is the area he has been most deliberate about — 'For my age, I'm in a good shape. I'm fit. I'm very active. I eat healthy. I train.' With no neglect there is no pain to price against, and the entire objection reduced to value: 'I don't think it's worth, for me... that I spend 1,000 euros or dollars per month on this.' Worth reading against the Robyn Stillwater assessment from the other direction — she was outside the stated ICP and closed at full price; he sits almost inside it and refused. Both point the same way: the stated criteria are not predicting who buys.
